targets.old_statement: U-turns die without five-hundred-foot visibility both ways, in city business districts, at no-U-turn signs, on limited-access expressways even with cross-paths, and in school zones, while narrow two-way streets allow three-point turnarounds that road tests may demand.

targets.statement: U-turns are illegal where other drivers cannot see your vehicle from five hundred feet in either direction, in New York City business districts, at NO U-TURN signs, on limited-access expressways even where paths connect the sides, and in school zones, whereas a three-point turn may be used on a narrow two-way street unless prohibited and may be required on your road test.
